_provenance.source: Python 3.11 zoneinfo over the IANA database, the UTC offset of each zone on 2025-01-20
_provenance.is_evidence_of: the UTC offset of twelve zones in January, which is enough for every example the deck makes
_provenance.is_not_evidence_of: any other month. Seven of these zones move an hour in summer. The deck's public API knows that; this table does not, and the notebooks say so.
